purpose: Test whether the U4 graph/RF complementarity survives spatially unmonitored stations.
blend_grid: alpha in {0.00, 0.05, ..., 1.00}; alpha multiplies temporal RF prediction
selection: alpha selected independently within each analyte x mask x seed on validation cells using raw-scale MAE; test labels are read only once for final evaluation
decision: If spatial gains are absent, retain the blend only as a temporal-extrapolation diagnostic and do not expand the model.
